summary: Galaxy Gaming filed an 8-K reporting entry into an amended employment agreement with President and CEO Matt Reback effective September 1, 2026, and disclosed under Item 5.02. Terms: term extended through May 31, 2029; base salary $367,500 for the year ending August 31, 2027 and $385,000 thereafter; annual bonus target 75% of base; option for 150,000 shares struck at $1.656 vesting 50,000 annually from September 1, 2027; conditional 150,000 restricted shares tied to 2028 metrics. This is a compensatory arrangement, not a special situation.
